target.outcome: Daily all-cancer deaths (bounded slice; article also specified 25 site-specific outcomes)
target.geography: Sao Paulo municipality/city, Brazil (bounded from 5,570 municipalities)
target.population: Individual SIM all-cancer death records with municipality of occurrence code 355030
target.exposure_assignment: Daily Sao Paulo city-coordinate PM2.5 estimate, transformed to observed three-day lag 0-2 mean; explicit proxy for article population-weighted municipality grid mean
target.model: Time-stratified case-crossover conditional logistic regression; 3 or 4 same-weekday controls in same calendar month
covariates: NASA POWER coordinate daily temperature (linear and quadratic terms)

substitutions.reason: This was the first independently recovered daily outcome/exposure overlap suitable for an executable bounded fit.
The recovered public city series preserves daily PM2.5 and lag calculation but not the article spatial support.

substitutions.published: Population-weighted ERA5 temperature cross-basis, RH, and public holiday
substitutions.reanalysis: NASA POWER coordinate temperature linear/quadratic terms and RH; no holiday term
substitutions.reason: Bounded public-weather implementation; explicitly reduced adjustment.

substitutions.published: All cancer plus 25 site-specific variants and subgroups
substitutions.reason: Only the principal all-cancer bounded slice was fit; variants remain unestimated.

coverage.rule: Require three consecutive observed calendar days for lag 0-2 PM2.5 and weather on each case and referent date; no imputation.
coverage.notes: 353/365 PM2.5 source dates were recovered (all month-ends missing); 329 consecutive-date lagged days and 16,801 death strata were fitted.

effects.label: All-cancer mortality, Sao Paulo 2019 bounded slice
effects.contrast: 10 ug/m3 increase in observed PM2.5 lag 0-2 mean
effects.native_contrast: 1 ug/m3 increase in PM2.5 lag 0-2 mean

reported_variants: All-cancer, Sao Paulo 2019 bounded slice; site-specific/subgroup/period variants not fit

blockers: The result does not recover the article's national 5,570-municipality, 2000-2019 population-weighted gridded PM2.5 panel.
The public daily city PM2.5 series omits all 2019 month-end dates and is a city-coordinate spatial proxy.
Site-specific, sex, age, and multi-period article variants were not fit in this one-city/one-year bounded analysis.
